name: HC30a: Total Eligible
description:
Number of active ART patients whose 12-month anniversary after ART initiation falls within the reporting period and are therefore eligible for the 12-month post-ART-initiation viral load assessment.
The patient must have a documented art_start_date, DATE_ADD(art_start_date, INTERVAL 12 MONTH) must fall within :startDate and :endDate, the patient must be represented in the HIV ART summary, and must satisfy the active-on-ART rule by having an ART encounter during the reporting period or a return_visit_date extending beyond :endDate.
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f
configJson:
{
  "version": 1,
  "patientIdColumn": "patient_id",
  "populationQuery": {
    "extractFrom": "sqlTemplate"
  },
  "supportsRedisaggregation": true,
  "redisaggregationStrategy": "population-extraction",
  "themeIndependent": true,
  "dataSources": [
    "mamba_fact_patients_latest_regimen",
    "mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card",
    "mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary"
  ],
  "sqlTemplate": "SELECT DISTINCT r.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_patients_latest_regimen r
WHERE r.art_start_date IS NOT NULL

  /* 12-month ART milestone falls within reporting period */
  AND DATE_ADD(r.art_start_date, INTERVAL 12 MONTH) >= :startDate
  AND DATE_ADD(r.art_start_date, INTERVAL 12 MONTH)
      < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

  /* HIV patient */
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary s
      WHERE s.patient_id = r.patient_id
  )

  /* Active on ART */
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
      WHERE a.patient_id = r.patient_id
        AND (
            (
                a.encounter_date >= :startDate
                AND a.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
            )
            OR a.return_visit_date > :endDate
        )
  );",
  "sqlPreview": "SELECT DISTINCT r.patient_id AS patient_id FROM mamba_fact_patients_latest_regimen r
WHERE r.art_start_date IS NOT NULL

  /* 12-month ART milestone falls within reporting period */
  AND DATE_ADD(r.art_start_date, INTERVAL 12 MONTH) >= :startDate
  AND DATE_ADD(r.art_start_date, INTERVAL 12 MONTH)
      < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

  /* HIV patient */
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary s
      WHERE s.patient_id = r.patient_id
  )

  /* Active on ART */
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
      WHERE a.patient_id = r.patient_id
        AND (
            (
                a.encounter_date >= :startDate
                AND a.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
            )
            OR a.return_visit_date > :endDate
        )
  );"
}
